findings.description: If receiptHandle.writeFile throws after runApprovedDeletion returned, main replaces the existing report with a new object lacking mutationRequested. The fixed summary defaults it to false although the irreversible delete could already have completed. Receipt close failures preserve the report, but write failures do not.
findings.evidence: Source control flow: report assigned at130; awaited write at131; replacement catch at133; default false at141. Main was deliberately not executed under task boundary.
findings.fix: Preserve prior report and actual/uncertain mutationRequested when recording receipt-write failure; set an explicit persistence-failure stage and retain STOP instructions/occupied reservation. Exercise the actual reused failure projection with a pure regression.

findings.description: safeFailure reads name/code/status again after validating the first getter result. A changing getter returns an allowlisted primitive first and a private diagnostic second; all three output fields can contain it. Throwing accessors can also break failure projection.

findings.fix: Read each field at most once inside defensive try/catch, validate cached primitive values and emit only cached accepted values. Add changing and throwing getter tests; never echo messages/stack/stdout/stderr.
